Hi Maya —

Thanks for the interest in Redwood. I wanted to get a 60-minute discovery on the calendar so we can align on goals, architecture constraints, and procurement/security checklists. I’ll bring Karthik (SE) for the technical portion and loop in Lukas on any infra/ops questions.

- Tue 16 May — 9:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu 18 May — 09:30–10:30 or 11:00–12:00

If procurement or secops need to join, let me know which of the above works and I’ll send a calendar invite. If engineering prefers a deeper technical follow-up instead of a long discovery, say so and we’ll split into two sessions.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.
